en.headline: Customs arrest two over HK$35 million money-laundering linked to earlier drug case
en.dek: Financial investigation of a 2025 narcotics seizure uncovered suspicious transfers of about HK$35 million through the personal bank accounts of two 33-year-old local men between January 2024 and August 2025.
body: Hong Kong Customs announced on Thursday that it had arrested two 33-year-old local men for suspected money laundering involving roughly HK$35 million in crime proceeds, following a follow-up probe into a dangerous-drugs case detected in 2025.

In August last year Customs seized drugs worth about HK$8.3 million and arrested one of the men. Subsequent fund-flow analysis showed numerous suspicious transactions totalling about HK$35 million in the personal bank accounts of the arrested man and another 33-year-old between January 2024 and August 2025. The funds were believed to represent proceeds of an indictable offence.

Officers took enforcement action on Wednesday and charged the pair with dealing with property known or reasonably believed to represent proceeds of an indictable offence under the Organized and Serious Crimes Ordinance. An investigation continues and further arrests are not ruled out.

Under the ordinance the maximum penalty is a fine of HK$5 million and 14 years’ imprisonment; the proceeds are also liable to confiscation. Customs urged the public to report suspected money-laundering activities through its 24-hour hotline or online channels.

zh.headline: 海關跟進毒品案拘兩男 涉清洗黑錢約3500萬元
zh.dek: 根據2025年一宗毒品案財富調查，兩名33歲本地男子個人銀行戶口於2024年1月至2025年8月有大量可疑交易，涉款約3500萬元，昨被控處理犯罪得益。
body: 香港海關今日公布，根據一宗於2025年偵破的毒品案件作跟進調查，昨日成功偵破一宗懷疑清洗黑錢案，涉款約3500萬元，拘捕兩名33歲本地男子。
去年8月，海關偵破一宗涉及約830萬元毒品的案件，拘捕其中一名男子。其後財富調查及資金流向分析發現，該男子與另一名33歲本地男子的個人銀行戶口於2024年1月至2025年8月期間有大量可疑交易，合共約3500萬元，相信為犯罪得益。
海關昨日採取行動，根據《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》以「處理已知道或相信為代表從可公訴罪行的得益的財產」罪名拘捕兩人。案件仍在調查中，不排除有更多人被捕。
根據法例，一經定罪最高可被判罰款500萬元及監禁14年，相關犯罪得益亦可被沒收。市民可透過海關熱線或網上渠道舉報懷疑洗黑錢活動。
